originalTitle: Why the Market Dipped But Crescent Energy (CRGY) Gained Today
summary: In the latest trading session, Crescent Energy (CRGY) closed at $14.41, marking a +1.19% move from the previous day.
content:
Crescent Energy (CRGY) closed at $14.41 in the latest trading session, marking a +1.19% move from the prior day. This move outpaced the S&P 500's daily loss of 0.59%. At the same time, the Dow lost 0.6%, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq lost 0.65%.

The oil and gas company's stock has climbed by 18.08% in the past month, exceeding the Oils-Energy sector's gain of 9.15% and the S&P 500's loss of 1.37%.

The investment community will be paying close attention to the earnings performance of Crescent Energy in its upcoming release. The company is expected to report EPS of $0.59, up 68.57% from the prior-year quarter. Meanwhile, our latest consensus estimate is calling for revenue of $1.21 billion, up 40.1% from the prior-year quarter.

Regarding the entire year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates forecast earnings of $2.53 per share and revenue of $4.94 billion, indicating changes of +40.56% and +37.98%, respectively, compared to the previous year.

Any recent changes to analyst estimates for Crescent Energy should also be noted by investors. These recent revisions tend to reflect the evolving nature of short-term business trends. Consequently, upward revisions in estimates express analysts' positivity towards the business operations and its ability to generate profits.

Our research demonstrates that these adjustments in estimates directly associate with imminent stock price performance. Investors can capitalize on this by using the Zacks Rank. This model considers these estimate changes and provides a simple, actionable rating system.

Ranging from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), the Zacks Rank system has a proven, outside-audited track record of outperformance, with #1 stocks returning an average of +25% annually since 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has witnessed an unchanged state. At present, Crescent Energy boasts a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

Looking at its valuation, Crescent Energy is holding a Forward P/E ratio of 5.64. This valuation marks a discount compared to its industry average Forward P/E of 17.86.

The Alternative Energy - Other industry is part of the Oils-Energy sector. This group has a Zacks Industry Rank of 94, putting it in the top 39% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank evaluates the power of our distinct industry groups by determining the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks forming the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

Keep in mind to rely on Zacks.com to watch all these stock-impacting metrics, and more, in the succeeding trading sessions.

chineseTitle: 为什么市场下跌但 Crescent Energy (CRGY) 今天上涨
chineseSummary: 在最新的交易日中，Crescent Energy (CRGY) 收于 14.41 美元，较前一交易日上涨 1.19%。
chineseContent:
Crescent Energy (CRGY) 在最新交易日收于 14.41 美元，较前一日上涨 1.19%。这一举措超过了标准普尔 500 指数 0.59% 的日跌幅。与此同时，道指下跌 0.6%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌 0.65%。

过去一个月，该石油和天然气公司的股价上涨了 18.08%，超过了石油能源板块 9.15% 的涨幅和标准普尔 500 指数 1.37% 的跌幅。

投资界将密切关注Crescent Energy即将发布的盈利表现。该公司预计每股收益为 0.59 美元，较上年同期增长 68.57%。与此同时，我们最新的共识预测收入为 12.1 亿美元，比去年同期增长 40.1%。

就全年而言，Zacks 一致预期每股收益为 2.53 美元，营收为 49.4 亿美元，与上年相比分别变化 +40.56% 和 +37.98%。

投资者还应注意 Crescent Energy 分析师预测的任何近期变化。这些最近的修订往往反映了短期业务趋势不断变化的性质。因此，预估的上调表明了分析师对业务运营及其产生利润的能力的积极态度。

我们的研究表明，这些预估调整与即将到来的股价表现直接相关。投资者可以通过使用 Zacks Rank 来利用这一点。该模型考虑了这些估计变化并提供了一个简单、可操作的评级系统。

从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），Zacks Rank 系统拥有经过验证的、经过外部审计的优异表现记录，自 1988 年以来，排名第一的股票平均每年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天内，Zacks 共识每股收益估计保持不变。目前，新月能源拥有 Zacks 排名第三（持有）。

从估值来看，Crescent Energy 的远期市盈率为 5.64。与行业平均远期市盈率 17.86 相比，这一估值存在折扣。

替代能源-其他行业是石油能源行业的一部分。该集团的 Zacks 行业排名为 94，在所有 250 多个行业中排名前 39%。

Zacks 行业排名通过确定构成行业组的个股的平均 Zacks 排名来评估我们不同行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
